title: AWS Auto Scaling group (terraform-aws-modules/autoscaling/aws)
description: Provision an EC2 Auto Scaling group with its launch template via ACK ec2 (LaunchTemplate) and autoscaling (AutoScalingGroup). Input names mirror the terraform-aws-modules/autoscaling/aws module (core subset of its inputs).

region.title: AWS region
region.description: AWS region for the Auto Scaling group and launch template. Krateo/ACK wiring (not a Terraform module input). Empty inherits the ACK controller default.

name.title: name
name.description: Name used across the resources created.

min_size.title: min_size
min_size.description: The minimum size of the autoscaling group.

max_size.title: max_size
max_size.description: The maximum size of the autoscaling group.

desired_capacity.title: desired_capacity
desired_capacity.description: The number of Amazon EC2 instances that should be running in the autoscaling group.

image_id.title: image_id
image_id.description: The AMI from which to launch the instance.

instance_type.title: instance_type
instance_type.description: The type of the instance. If present then `instance_requirements` cannot be present.

vpc_zone_identifier.title: vpc_zone_identifier
vpc_zone_identifier.description: A list of subnet IDs to launch resources in. Subnets automatically determine which availability zones the group will reside. Conflicts with `availability_zones`. These reference EXISTING subnets (passed through as IDs); this stack does not create them.

availability_zones.title: availability_zones
availability_zones.description: A list of one or more availability zones for the group. Used for EC2-Classic and default subnets when not specifying `vpc_zone_identifier`. Conflicts with `vpc_zone_identifier`.

health_check_type.title: health_check_type
health_check_type.description: `EC2` or `ELB`. Controls how health checking is done.

health_check_grace_period.title: health_check_grace_period
health_check_grace_period.description: Time (in seconds) after instance comes into service before checking health.

default_cooldown.title: default_cooldown
default_cooldown.description: The amount of time, in seconds, after a scaling activity completes before another scaling activity can start.

capacity_rebalance.title: capacity_rebalance
capacity_rebalance.description: Indicates whether capacity rebalance is enabled.

key_name.title: key_name
key_name.description: The key name that should be used for the instance. References an EXISTING EC2 key pair (passed through by name); this stack does not create it.

ebs_optimized.title: ebs_optimized
ebs_optimized.description: If true, the launched EC2 instance will be EBS-optimized.

user_data.title: user_data
user_data.description: The Base64-encoded user data to provide when launching the instance.

security_groups.title: security_groups
security_groups.description: A list of security group IDs to associate with the launch template. These reference EXISTING security groups (passed through as IDs); this stack does not create them.

target_group_arns.title: target_group_arns
target_group_arns.description: A set of `aws_alb_target_group` ARNs, for use with Application or Network Load Balancing. These reference EXISTING target groups (passed through as ARNs); this stack does not create them.

iam_instance_profile_arn.title: iam_instance_profile_arn
iam_instance_profile_arn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an existing IAM instance profile. Used when `create_iam_instance_profile` = `false`. References an EXISTING instance profile (passed through as ARN); this stack does not create it.

launch_template_name.title: launch_template_name
launch_template_name.description: Name of launch template to be created. Empty defaults to `<name>`.

launch_template_version.title: launch_template_version
launch_template_version.description: Launch template version. Can be version number, `$Latest`, or `$Default`.

tags.title: tags
tags.description: A map of tags to assign to resources.
